correctness.rationale: Exact Markov images on \(2k\) half-open unit cells; every graph return inverse is a contraction because every graph cycle visits both central gain-\(k\) cells; only the jump endpoint orbit has two symbolic periodic germ codings. Eliminating deterministic strings proves the determinant identity in the accompanying proof, and one surplus length-(k+1) orbit produces the numerator. Matrix is primitive, gives root and growth by Perron-Frobenius. Replayed exact checker: 96 tests \(k=2,\ldots,5\), \(n=1,\ldots,10\); infinite proof is analytic.
